summary: The highest documented score. Captain Milk holds the top ATK so Passion Pay and Rapid Promotion land on it, and its stacking ATK buff reaches the packed formation; Pomegranate's beam is routed down the ATK order to Scorpion and Figure, which the author calls the key target. Supports stay at Lv.70 or below so Milk reaches the centre early, and every cookie that would steal the beam, charge off or summon is levelled out of the top 40. Lime and Cheesecake joined by 2026-09-22, after the 9/10 update let the stronger stacked buff win. The 40 themselves are posted only as roster screenshots.
